title: After Twenty Years
synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of O. Henry’s short story “After Twenty Years”.

fullText.simplified:
二十年后（一）

    这是一个小城市。一个警察正在街道上巡逻。虽然还不到晚上十点，但因为天气很冷，路上的人很少。
    警察一家店一家店地察看着。这是一个小城市，现在这个时候，只有几家便利店和餐馆亮着灯，其他的商店都早早地关灯关门了。
    警察右转进了另一条街继续巡逻。突然，他放慢了脚步。一家已经关灯关门的书店门前站着一个男人，他手里拿着一根没有点的烟。
    他看到警察走向他，他说：“没事，警察先生。我只是在这儿等一个朋友。这是我们二十年前定下的约会。二十年前，这里还不是一家书店，而是一家餐馆，叫‘老李餐馆’。”
    “那家餐馆五年前关门了。因为老李老了，不能开餐馆了。”警察说。
    男人拿出打火机，用打火机点了烟。火光照出一张细长的脸。
    男人抽着烟，回忆道：“二十年前的这个晚上，我在老李餐馆和我的好朋友张汉一起吃饭。张汉是我最好的朋友，也是这个世界上最好的人。我和他都是在这个城市里长大的，我们从小就在一起玩儿。那一年，我二十岁，小汉十八岁。第二天一大早，我就要离开这个小城市了。我一直想去大城市，我想做出一点成绩，我想变成有钱人。这些在这个小城市里是不可能做到的。而小汉不想离开这个城市，他觉得这个小小的城市就是最好的地方。于是，在那天晚上我们约好了，二十年后的今天，晚上十点，不管我们身在哪里，不管我们过得怎么样，都要在这里见面。”
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
二十年後（一）

    這是一個小城市。一個警察正在街道上巡邏。雖然還不到晚上十點，但因為天氣很冷，路上的人很少。
    警察一家店一家店地察看著。這是一個小城市，現在這個時候，只有幾家便利店和餐館亮著燈，其他的商店都早早地關燈關門了。
    警察右轉進了另一條街繼續巡邏。突然，他放慢了腳步。一家已經關燈關門的書店門前站著一個男人，他手裡拿著一根沒有點的煙。
    他看到警察走向他，他說：“沒事，警察先生。我只是在這兒等一個朋友。這是我們二十年前定下的約會。二十年前，這裡還不是一家書店，而是一家餐館，叫‘老李餐館’。”
    “那家餐館五年前關門了。因為老李老了，不能開餐館了。”警察說。
    男人拿出打火機，用打火機點了煙。火光照出一張細長的臉。
    男人抽著煙，回憶道：“二十年前的這個晚上，我在老李餐館和我的好朋友張漢一起吃飯。張漢是我最好的朋友，也是這個世界上最好的人。我和他都是在這個城市裡長大的，我們從小就在一起玩兒。那一年，我二十歲，小漢十八歲。第二天一大早，我就要離開這個小城市了。我一直想去大城市，我想做出一點成績，我想變成有錢人。這些在這個小城市裡是不可能做到的。而小漢不想離開這個城市，他覺得這個小小的城市就是最好的地方。於是，在那天晚上我們約好了，二十年後的今天，晚上十點，不管我們身在哪裏，不管我們過得怎麼樣，都要在這裡見面。”
（未完待續）

sentences.simplified: 这是一个小城市。
sentences.traditional: 這是一個小城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge xiǎo chéng shì
sentences.english: This is a small town.

sentences.simplified: 一个警察正在街道上巡逻。
sentences.traditional: 一個警察正在街道上巡邏。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge jǐng chá zhèng zài jiē dào shang xún luó
sentences.english: A policeman was patrolling the street.

sentences.simplified: 虽然还不到晚上十点，
sentences.traditional: 雖然還不到晚上十點，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán hái bú dào wǎn shang shí diǎn
sentences.english: Although it hadn’t yet reached 10 o’clock at night, ..

sentences.simplified: 但因为天气很冷，路上的人很少。
sentences.traditional: 但因為天氣很冷，路上的人很少。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yīn wèi tiān qì hěn lěng lù shang de rén hěn shǎo
sentences.english: .. but because the weather was very cold, there were very few people on the road.

sentences.simplified: 警察一家店一家店地察看着。
sentences.traditional: 警察一家店一家店地察看著。
sentences.pinyin: jǐng chá yì jiā diàn yì jiā diàn de chá kàn zhe
sentences.english: The policeman was carefully looking shop by shop.

sentences.simplified: 这是一个小城市，现在这个时候，只有几家便利店和餐馆亮着灯，
sentences.traditional: 這是一個小城市，現在這個時候，只有幾家便利店和餐館亮著燈，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge xiǎo chéng shì xiàn zài zhè ge shí hou zhǐ yǒu jǐ jiā biàn lì diàn hé cān guǎn liàng zhe dēng
sentences.english: This was a small town. Now at this time, only the lamps of a few convenience stores and restaurants were shining.

sentences.simplified: 其他的商店都早早地关灯关门了。
sentences.traditional: 其他的商店都早早地關燈關門了。
sentences.pinyin: qí tā de shāng diàn dōu zǎo zǎo de guān dēng guān mén le
sentences.english: All the other shops had turned off their lights and closed their doors much earlier.

sentences.simplified: 警察右转进了另一条街继续巡逻。
sentences.traditional: 警察右轉進了另一條街繼續巡邏。
sentences.pinyin: jǐng chá yòu zhuǎn jìn le lìng yì tiáo jiē jì xù xún luó
sentences.english: The policeman turned right and entered another street and continued on his patrol.

sentences.simplified: 突然，他放慢了脚步。
sentences.traditional: 突然，他放慢了腳步。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán tā fàng màn le jiǎo bù
sentences.english: Suddenly, he slowed his pace.

sentences.simplified: 一家已经关灯关门的书店门前站着一个男人，他手里拿着一根没有点的烟。
sentences.traditional: 一家已經關燈關門的書店門前站著一個男人，他手裡拿著一根沒有點的煙。
sentences.pinyin: yì jiā yǐ jīng guān dēng guān mén de shū diàn mén qián zhàn zhe yí ge nán rén tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yì gēn méi yǒu diǎn de yān
sentences.english: At the front door of an already shut and closed book shop there stood a man holding an unlit cigarette in his hand.

sentences.simplified: 他看到警察走向他，他说：“没事，警察先生。我只是在这儿等一个朋友。
sentences.traditional: 他看到警察走向他，他說：“沒事，警察先生。我只是在這兒等一個朋友。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào jǐng chá zǒu xiàng tā tā shuō méi shì jǐng chá xiān sheng wǒ zhǐ shì zài zhè‘r děng yí ge péng you
sentences.english: He saw the policeman walking towards him, and said: “It’s alright, Mr. Police. I’m only here waiting for a friend.”

sentences.simplified: 这是我们二十年前定下的约会。
sentences.traditional: 這是我們二十年前定下的約會。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ men èr shí nián qián dìng xià de yuē huì
sentences.english: “This is where we decided to meet twenty years ago.”

sentences.simplified: 二十年前，这里还不是一家书店，而是一家餐馆，叫‘老李餐馆’。”
sentences.traditional: 二十年前，這裡還不是一家書店，而是一家餐館，叫‘老李餐館’。”
sentences.pinyin: èr shí nián qián zhè lǐ hái bú shì yì jiā shū diàn ér shì yì jiā cān guǎn jiào lǎo lǐ cān guǎn
sentences.english: “Twenty years ago, this was not yet a book shop, but a restaurant called ‘Old Li’s Restaurant’.”

sentences.simplified: “那家餐馆五年前关门了。因为老李老了，不能开餐馆了。”警察说。
sentences.traditional: “那家餐館五年前關門了。因為老李老了，不能開餐館了。”警察說。
sentences.pinyin: nà jiā cān guǎn wǔ nián qián guān mén le yīn wèi lǎo lǐ lǎo le bù néng kāi cān guǎn le jǐng chá shuō
sentences.english: “That restaurant shut down five years ago. Because Old Li got older, he couldn’t run the restaurant.” the policeman said.

sentences.simplified: 男人拿出打火机，用打火机点了烟。
sentences.traditional: 男人拿出打火機，用打火機點了煙。
sentences.pinyin: nán rén ná chū dǎ huǒ jī yòng dǎ huǒ jī diǎn le yān
sentences.english: The man took out a lighter and used it to light the cigarette.

sentences.simplified: 火光照出一张细长的脸。
sentences.traditional: 火光照出一張細長的臉。
sentences.pinyin: huǒ guāng zhào chū yì zhāng xì cháng de liǎn
sentences.english: The flame lit up a long and thin face.

sentences.simplified: 男人抽着烟，回忆道：
sentences.traditional: 男人抽著煙，回憶道：
sentences.pinyin: nán rén chōu zhe yān huí yì dào
sentences.english: The man took a drag of smoke, and recalled:

sentences.simplified: “二十年前的这个晚上，我在老李餐馆和我的好朋友张汉一起吃饭。
sentences.traditional: “二十年前的這個晚上，我在老李餐館和我的好朋友張漢一起吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: èr shí nián qián de zhè ge wǎn shang wǒ zài lǎo lǐ cān guǎn hé wǒ de hǎo péng you zhāng hàn yì qǐ chī fàn
sentences.english: “This evening twenty years ago, I was at Old Li’s Restaurant with my good friend Zhang Han eating together.”

sentences.simplified: 张汉是我最好的朋友，也是这个世界上最好的人。
sentences.traditional: 張漢是我最好的朋友，也是這個世界上最好的人。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng hàn shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you yě shì zhè ge shì jiè shang zuì hǎo de rén
sentences.english: “Zhang Han was my very best friend, and also the best person in this world.”

sentences.simplified: 我和他都是在这个城市里长大的，我们从小就在一起玩儿。
sentences.traditional: 我和他都是在這個城市裡長大的，我們從小就在一起玩兒。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé tā dōu shì zài zhè ge chéng shì lǐ zhǎng dà de wǒ men cóng xiǎo jiù zài yì qǐ wán'r
sentences.english: “Him and I both grew up in this town, and we’ve had fun together since childhood.”

sentences.simplified: 那一年，我二十岁，小汉十八岁。第二天一大早，我就要离开这个小城市了。
sentences.traditional: 那一年，我二十歲，小漢十八歲。第二天一大早，我就要離開這個小城市了。
sentences.pinyin: nà yì nián wǒ èr shí suì xiǎo hàn shí bā suì dì èr tiān yí dà zǎo wǒ jiù yào lí kāi zhè ge xiǎo chéng shì le
sentences.english: “That year I was 20 years old, Xiao Han was 18. Early in the morning the next day, I was going to leave this small town.”

sentences.simplified: 我一直想去大城市，我想做出一点成绩，我想变成有钱人。
sentences.traditional: 我一直想去大城市，我想做出一點成績，我想變成有錢人。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yì zhí xiǎng qù dà chéng shì wǒ xiǎng zuò chū yì diǎn chéng jì wǒ xiǎng biàn chéng yǒu qián rén
sentences.english: “I wanted to go to the big city all along, I wanted to make some achievement, I wanted to become a rich person.”

sentences.simplified: 这些在这个小城市里是不可能做到的。
sentences.traditional: 這些在這個小城市裡是不可能做到的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē zài zhè ge xiǎo chéng shì lǐ shì bù kě néng zuò dào de
sentences.english: “These things could not be done in this small town.”

sentences.simplified: 而小汉不想离开这个城市，他觉得这个小小的城市就是最好的地方。
sentences.traditional: 而小漢不想離開這個城市，他覺得這個小小的城市就是最好的地方。
sentences.pinyin: ér xiǎo hàn bù xiǎng lí kāi zhè ge chéng shì tā jué de zhè ge xiǎo xiǎo de chéng shì jiù shì zuì hǎo de dì fang
sentences.english: “But Xiao Han didn’t want to leave this town. He felt that this very small town was the best place.”

sentences.simplified: 于是，在那天晚上我们约好了，二十年后的今天，晚上十点，
sentences.traditional: 於是，在那天晚上我們約好了，二十年後的今天，晚上十點，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì zài nà tiān wǎn shang wǒ men yuē hǎo le èr shí nián hòu de jīn tiān wǎn shang shí diǎn
sentences.english: “So, on that evening we made an appointment, that on this day twenty years later, at ten o’clock in the evening,” ..

sentences.simplified: 不管我们身在哪里，不管我们过得怎么样，都要在这里见面。”
sentences.traditional: 不管我們身在哪裏，不管我們過得怎麼樣，都要在這裡見面。”
sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn wǒ men shēn zài nǎ lǐ bù guǎn wǒ men guò de zěn me yàng dōu yào zài zhè lǐ jiàn miàn
sentences.english: .. “no matter where we were, no matter how we had gotten by, to still meet each other here.”

sentences.traditional: （未完待續）

sentences.english: (To be continued)

raw.synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of O. Henry’s short story “After Twenty Years”.
sentence_translations: After Twenty Years (Part 1)
This is a small town.
A policeman was patrolling the street.
Although it hadn’t yet reached 10 o’clock at night, ..
.. but because the weather was very cold, there were very few people on the road.
The policeman was carefully looking shop by shop.
This was a small town. Now at this time, only the lamps of a few convenience stores and restaurants were shining.
All the other shops had turned off their lights and closed their doors much earlier.
The policeman turned right and entered another street and continued on his patrol.
Suddenly, he slowed his pace.
At the front door of an already shut and closed book shop there stood a man holding an unlit cigarette in his hand.
He saw the policeman walking towards him, and said: “It’s alright, Mr. Police. I’m only here waiting for a friend.”
“This is where we decided to meet twenty years ago.”
“Twenty years ago, this was not yet a book shop, but a restaurant called ‘Old Li’s Restaurant’.”
“That restaurant shut down five years ago. Because Old Li got older, he couldn’t run the restaurant.” the policeman said.
The man took out a lighter and used it to light the cigarette.
The flame lit up a long and thin face.
The man took a drag of smoke, and recalled:
“This evening twenty years ago, I was at Old Li’s Restaurant with my good friend Zhang Han eating together.”
“Zhang Han was my very best friend, and also the best person in this world.”
“Him and I both grew up in this town, and we’ve had fun together since childhood.”
“That year I was 20 years old, Xiao Han was 18. Early in the morning the next day, I was going to leave this small town.”
“I wanted to go to the big city all along, I wanted to make some achievement, I wanted to become a rich person.”
“These things could not be done in this small town.”
“But Xiao Han didn’t want to leave this town. He felt that this very small town was the best place.”
“So, on that evening we made an appointment, that on this day twenty years later, at ten o’clock in the evening,” ..
.. “no matter where we were, no matter how we had gotten by, to still meet each other here.”
